text:
deploy-bot: preflight failed: SBOM provenance missing signature for artifact service-image:rc-3. scan-ref sbom-1758009999

priya: ugh. CI printed "no cosign signature attached" on the image. Is this a builder issue or release pipeline?

tom: build infra shows cosign attach job completed but returned 0 with no artifact. investigating.

olga-security: per compliance we need either a valid signature or an approved exception. What are our options in next change window?

kate-qa: canary already in one region. We can freeze and quarantine canary traffic. QA can run extra smoke tests if we get a signed image.

paul-ops: change window is 2h. If we delay >1h we miss the night cutover and would need manual approval tomorrow.

nina-pm: product impact: RC-3 contains billing fix targeted for EU customers. Delaying impacts small set of customers but acceptable if security requires. Please quantify ETA.

tom: preliminary root cause: cosign key agent failed to push signature due to transient network error to KMS. Retry may succeed quickly. ETA ~15-30m.

olga-security: security preference: wait for signature if ETA <1h. If retry fails, we consider a controlled rollback to rc-2 or request a temporary exception logged to audit with mitigation.

priya: can we carve out EU and proceed in other regions? The EU fix is critical for EU billing bug.

paul-ops: routing carveout possible but would require duplication of release tags and manual routing. Risky and adds complexity. Prefer single global decision.

nina-pm: lean toward waiting for signature. We can notify a small group of customers about brief delay.

olga-security: if signature does not appear in 45m, escalate to legal for approved exception. Legal will need the mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: holding rollout. quarantining canary. Action: rollback prevented, rollout paused.

kate-qa: I'll keep running regression checks on the staged image in case signature lands.

(20m later)

deploy-bot: cosign attach retry completed by build-agent-7. Signature present. sbom-1758009999 now signed.

olga-security: verifying signature... looks valid, key ID matches release-key-2026. No provenance mismatch.

priya: great. can we resume rollout?

paul-ops: resume is fine. Re-run canary traffic for 10 minutes extra and monitor metrics.

nina-pm: please add a release note entry: "RC-3 delayed briefly due to SBOM signature propagation; rollout completed after verification." Also add internal compliance log with timestamp and cosign job output.

olga-security: filing compliance ticket SEC-2026-1758-sbom-audit with evidence attached.

deploy-bot: resuming rollout. canary -> full. job 9921 started.

kate-qa: canary smoke OK after extra checks. no regressions.

deploy-bot: job 9921 COMPLETED OK. rollout finished at 1758001800.

olga-security: closing this thread pending audit closure. Recommend follow-up: add CI gate to fail build if cosign attach returns non-200, and add automated retry + alert to infra.

priya: noted. creating infra task to harden cosign step and follow-up PR to build scripts.

nina-pm: thanks everyone. I'll send a short customer-facing blurb and link to release notes.
